prompt: theCore STM32F407G-DISC1 STLINK V2.1 OpenOCD config file
answer:
For theCore, use the OpenOCD board configuration:

```bash
openocd -f board/stm32f429disc1.cfg
```

This is the recommended script for new STM32F407G-DISC1 boards with ST-LINK/V2.1.
